method: After the first CUDA_OUTER_AUTHORITY marker, sum coefficient_words in exactly 66 GPU_TRACE_OWNERSHIP records: one MAIN and one INTER commitment for each of 33 new outer proofs. Each word is one committed M31 trace cell. Fixed cells are separately derived from retired_preprocessed_bytes/4 in the accepted combined receipt.

observed_native_commitment_records.note: The resident manifest protocol commits native MAIN twice through bounded replay. This observed commitment work is not a count of unique trace cells; no division by replay multiplicity is used for the headline recursive totals.

interpretation: The recursive representation is itself a large workload. Reducing host preparation and launches is useful, but efficient folding, verifier representation and commitment verification remain structural optimization targets. These counts are not a GPU bandwidth lower bound or a measured speedup.
